result.title: Recoverability-Aware Evaluation of Diffusion Video Inpainting and Object Removal
result.summary: Video inpainting for object removal is scored over the whole hole, although the background behind the object is visible in other frames of the shot for some hole pixels and in no frame for others. A whole-hole score therefore mixes copying with generation and cannot show which of the two a remover does well. To separate the two, we propose recoverability-stratified evaluation, in which a point tracker run on the clean video labels each hole pixel by whether and how far away it is observed, so that fidelity and temporal stability can be reported per stratum against a copy reference. To reuse the observed content, we also propose evidence-guided sampling (EGS), which blends tracked colors into the clean-latent prediction of a video diffusion remover without training. On DAVIS, the perceptual advantage of three diffusion removers over flow propagation shrinks where the content is visible a few frames away (LPIPS difference-in-differences +0.046 to +0.056 against E2FGVI-HQ), and real paired captures show the same pattern for two of them. Their DAVIS hole warping error is two to four times that of ProPainter, and copying along clean-video tracks lowers their recoverable LPIPS by a quarter to two fifths. EGS closes 43% and 56% of the gap to this copy reference on held-out DAVIS when its colors come from clean-video tracks. With colors tracked on the masked input, a pre-registered confirmation finds no gain on MiniMax-Remover and a loss on ROSE. Diffusion removers thus leave observed content unused on DAVIS, and training-free reuse does not yet hold with tracked evidence.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出按「可恢复性」分层的视频物体移除修补评测：用点跟踪器在干净视频上标记每个孔洞像素是否在其他帧被观测到，从而把保真度与时间稳定性按层汇报、并与「直接复制」参考对比；同时提出免训练的 evidence-guided sampling，将跟踪得到的颜色混入视频扩散修补器的 clean-latent 预测。在 DAVIS 上据此指出扩散修补器在可恢复区域未利用已有观测内容。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「把可追踪的像素证据直接注入扩散 latent 预测」以及按证据可用性分层评价的思路，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据注入、latent 状态是否真正使用观测细节、以及视觉旁路评测设计的线索；但研究对象是视频修补而非推理，联系需较多核查。
